connector.name: MCP Mapmyindia
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for India maps - place search, nearby discovery, & directions powered by the Mappls API.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-mapmyindia. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the bhuvnsh account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.description: Mappls OAuth client secret (used with CLIENT_ID)
